_note: Foxtale product catalog used by the Recommended Skincare card. Product names, key ingredients and usage were taken from foxtale.in pages on the date in 'verified_on'. Formulas and availability change: check the product label before buying, and edit this file to update it. 'how_it_works' is general ingredient science, not a claim about a clinical result.

products.name: 2% Salicylic Acid Acne Control Face Wash
products.how_it_works: Salicylic acid is oil-soluble, so it can get inside pores and loosen the mix of oil and dead skin that clogs them, which is what many spots start from. Niacinamide helps regulate oil, and hyaluronic acid keeps the wash from leaving skin tight.
products.how_to_use: Massage onto damp skin for 30-60 seconds, then rinse. Use morning and night.
products.caution: Can feel drying if your skin is dry or irritated; use once a day at first.

products.name: 2-in-1 Hydrating Face Wash cum Makeup Remover
products.how_it_works: A gentle, non-stripping wash removes dirt without washing away the skin's own oils. Sodium hyaluronate draws water into the top layer of skin, and the algae extract leaves a light film that helps slow water loss after rinsing.
products.how_to_use: Massage a coin-sized amount onto damp skin, then rinse with lukewarm water. Use morning and night.
products.caution: Rinse with lukewarm, not hot, water.

products.name: 12% Niacinamide Face Serum with Azelaic Acid
products.how_it_works: Niacinamide helps regulate oil, supports the skin barrier and can fade the look of post-acne marks. Azelaic acid calms redness and brightens uneven tone, so the two work on spots, redness and evenness together.
products.how_to_use: Apply 2-3 pumps to clean, slightly damp skin, wait about a minute, then moisturize. Start every other day because of the 12% strength.
products.caution: Patch-test first. Stop if you get stinging or redness that lasts.

products.name: AHA BHA Exfoliating Serum
products.how_it_works: Glycolic acid (an AHA) loosens the dull layer of dead skin on the surface, which smooths rough texture. Salicylic acid (a BHA) works inside pores to clear buildup. Hyaluronic acid and niacinamide help offset dryness and irritation.
products.how_to_use: Use at night, up to three times a week, on clean dry skin. Avoid the eye and mouth area, and always wear sunscreen the next morning.
products.caution: Exfoliating acid: patch-test first, and skip it if your skin is red, dry or irritated.

products.name: Anti-Acne Spot Corrector Gel with Salicylic Acid
products.how_it_works: Applied only on an individual spot, salicylic acid dries out the surface oil and helps clear the pore, while the small area limits irritation to the rest of your face.
products.how_to_use: Dab a small amount on a spot only, at night, on clean dry skin.
products.caution: Spot use only; do not spread over dry or broken skin.
products.store_title: Acne Spot Corrector with Salicylic Acid

products.name: C for Yourself Vitamin C Serum
products.how_it_works: Vitamin C is an antioxidant that helps interrupt the pigment-making process and protects skin from sun-related damage, which supports a brighter, more even-looking tone over several weeks. Vitamin E helps keep it stable.
products.how_to_use: Apply a few drops to clean skin in the morning, before moisturizer and sunscreen. Results usually take 4-6 weeks.
products.caution: Strong active: patch-test first, and always follow with sunscreen.

products.name: Daily Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum
products.how_it_works: Hyaluronic acid is a humectant: it holds many times its weight in water and pulls it into the top layer of skin, which can make dull, tight-looking areas look plumper and calmer.
products.how_to_use: Apply to slightly damp skin after cleansing, then seal in with a moisturizer.
products.caution: Apply on damp skin; on very dry skin it works best under a moisturizer.

products.name: Niacinamide & Cica Oil Free Moisturizer
products.how_it_works: A light, oil-free gel gives skin water without adding grease. Niacinamide helps regulate oil, and cica (centella) is soothing and supports the skin barrier, which helps calm redness left by breakouts.
products.how_to_use: Apply after serum, morning and night.
products.store_title: Oil Balancing Moisturizer with Niacinamide & Cica

products.name: Nourishing Ceramide Moisturizer
products.how_it_works: Ceramides are natural fats that fill the gaps between skin cells and act like mortar in the skin barrier. Topping them up helps skin hold water, which can ease flaking and tightness and make rough patches look smoother.
products.how_to_use: Apply a generous layer to face and neck, morning and night.

products.name: SPF 50 PA++++ Matte Sunscreen
products.how_it_works: UV light darkens marks, worsens redness and makes tone look uneven, so sunscreen protects any other step you use. This one has a matte finish for shine-prone skin, and niacinamide adds oil control.
products.how_to_use: Apply two finger-lengths to face and neck as the last morning step, and reapply every 2-3 hours in the sun.
products.store_title: Ultra Matte Sunscreen SPF 50 PA ++++ for Oily Skin

products.name: SPF 50 PA++++ Dewy Finish Sunscreen
products.how_it_works: UV light damages the skin barrier, worsens redness and darkens marks. A broad-spectrum SPF 50 blocks UVA and UVB, and the dewy finish suits skin that looks dull or dry.
products.how_to_use: Apply two finger-lengths to face and neck as the last morning step, and reapply every 2-3 hours in the sun.
products.store_title: Dewy Finish Sunscreen SPF 50 PA ++++ SPF 50 for Dry Skin | In-Vivo Tested

products.name: Brightening Under Eye Cream
products.how_it_works: A vitamin C derivative helps lighten pigment-related darkness, hyaluronic acid plumps the thin under-eye skin with water so shadows look softer, and caffeine is used to make the area look less tired.
products.how_to_use: Use a pea-sized amount for both eyes, apply only on the orbital bone area and pat gently with minimal pressure.
products.caution: Keep it out of the eyes. Dark circles also come from sleep, genetics and thin skin, which a cream cannot change.

products.name: 0.15% Retinol Night Serum
products.how_it_works: Retinol speeds up how fast skin renews itself and supports collagen, which over weeks can soften fine lines, smooth rough texture and fade marks. Peptides, vitamin E and betaine help cushion and calm the skin.
products.how_to_use: Night only, on completely dry skin: 2-3 pumps, avoiding the eye and mouth area, then moisturize. Start once a week and build up to 2-3 times a week. Visible results usually take 6-12 weeks.
products.caution: Retinol can irritate: patch-test first, use sunscreen every morning, and skip it if you are pregnant or breastfeeding unless a doctor says otherwise.

products.name: Collagen-PDRN Serum
products.how_it_works: Foxtale describes a blend of collagen, PDRN, PGA and niacinamide made to support the skin's natural renewal, hydration and firmness. It is aimed at dullness, uneven-looking skin and early fine lines.
products.how_to_use: Apply a few drops to clean skin before your moisturizer.

products.name: 7% Niacinamide Brightening Complex Serum
products.how_it_works: Niacinamide helps regulate oil and blur the look of pores, and can fade the look of marks and dullness with regular use. The light gel-cream leaves a smooth, primer-like finish.
products.how_to_use: Apply to cleansed skin, then moisturize and use sunscreen in the morning.
products.caution: Patch-test first. Lighter than the 12% serum, so a gentler place to start.

products.name: Exfoliating Facial Toner
products.how_it_works: Lactic acid gently loosens dead skin that clogs pores and dulls the surface, so blackheads, rough texture and enlarged-looking pores can look better. Niacinamide helps with oil and pore appearance and hyaluronic acid keeps skin hydrated.
products.how_to_use: Put a few drops on a cotton pad and sweep over cleansed skin. Foxtale says it can be used morning and night; begin every other night and use sunscreen in the day.
products.caution: Exfoliating acid: patch-test first, and skip it if your skin is red, dry or irritated.
